item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Shakira "Hips Don't Lie" No Rap Version
item.description:
Hello everyone,

I'm looking for the No Rap Version of Shakira's hit single "Hips Don't Lie". While Wyclef Jean is still featured, the No Rap Version removes his verse.

A version was released on a UK Promo CD: https://www.discogs.com/release/17380546-Shakira-Featuring-Wyclef-Jean-Hips-Dont-Lie

Defunct radio station 95.5 WPLJ New York played a version that removed Wyclef Jean's verse but kept the instrumental bridge, while another station, WHUD 100.7 New York, played the version on the above Promo CD.

Any version will do in either lossy or lossless. Thank you.
